desc:
Defend the enclosure side-by-side with your friends!

In Wolf for Pets, the peace of the enclosure is threatened! A hungry and cunning wolf is trying to invade the territory to attack the pets, and the only way to stop him is by joining forces. Join players from around the world in real-time, use strategies, positioning, and skills to protect the fence and ensure no pets are caught. Unity is strength - will you be able to survive the attack?
